note: Small, shaded San Isabel NF campground at ~8,230 ft, 3 mi west of SH 69 on gravel CR 198 (about 11 mi north of Westcliffe), along Lake Creek in the riparian strip at the foot of the Sangre de Cristos; the Rainbow Trail (open to ATVs and motorcycles) and Sangre de Cristo Wilderness trailheads are nearby. Bear closure order in effect. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan and Pay listing: confirmed 11 sites, first-come only, $25 (2026, 2027), vault toilet, no potable water; added 14-night max and season note 'early May to late September'. No length published; FS limits each site to 'one small RV or small trailer'. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: CRITERIA (rig-length wording): FS singles this campground out: 'Parking for two vehicles or one small RV or small trailer is allowed at each site.' It is not PSICC boilerplate: Kenosha Pass, Ophir Creek and La Vista say 'one RV', Alvarado 'one recreational vehicle', Southside 'max length for RVs/trailers is 30 feet'. No agency length is stated. No review from the last 3 years by a reviewer whose own 23 ft+ rig fit was found (Campendium's only review, 2019, is a van of unstated length; ParkAdvisor's 'Max RV Length: 25 ft' is a directory figure, not used).

Website is the forest home page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/lake-creek-campground (recreation.gov Scan and Pay: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10165405).
Missing phone: San Carlos Ranger District 719-269-8500 (FS campground page). recreation.gov's contact text gives (719) 489-2034 (the concessionaire ExplorUS, goexplorus.com).
Operator: concessionaire-run (ExplorUS per recreation.gov contact; FS mentions 'concessionaire-run campsites'). Ownership federal stands.

Road: FS gives only 'travel 11 miles north on State Highway 69 to County Road 198, then 3 miles west', with no RV or 4WD wording. A 2019 Campendium review: 'Dirt road is a bit bumpy, but not bad at all, its grated.' The road beyond the campground toward the trailheads is reported (climb13ers) to need high-clearance 4WD; that is past the campground.

Open now: no PSICC alert names Lake Creek or CR 198; the Aspen Acres Fire order (San Carlos RD) closes Davenport and roads east of CO 165, not this area. Campground closed for the season (late September).

Waterfront (stored creekside): FS/recreation.gov 'some streamside sites'; on imagery the campground spur follows Lake Creek's riparian belt north of CR 198, but which sites are streamside cannot be seen under the canopy. Stands as stored.

Pin 38.2628,-105.6650 sits south of CR 198 in open scrub, ~486 m WSW of the FS/recreation.gov coordinate 38.26414,-105.65969 and ~400 m from the middle of the campground spur (about 38.2641,-105.6606 on imagery, between the FS point at its east entrance and Campendium's 38.26401,-105.66152). Re-pin to ~38.2641,-105.6606.
